asset.description: the item of plant the record is about

asset_hint.description: the free-text machine name the form carries when the top-level asset id is empty, used to resolve the `asset` anchor

asset_type.description: the plant type named on the form (e.g. the machine class)

certifier.description: the competent person who performed or certified the service

external_id.description: the source form-result's own identifier, as text

form_title.description: the tenant's own name for the maintenance form the record was captured on; the key the SAS value-map is bound to

hour_meter_reading.description: the second form family's hour/odometer reading at service

inspection_class.description: pre-operational / routine / major inspection or service

interval_basis.description: why the next inspection/service is due — statutory interval, a competent person's examination scheme, or the manufacturer's recommendation

jurisdiction.description: the WHS/examination regime whose interval and retention rule apply

labour_hours.description: labour hours booked to the service

location.description: the place named on the form where the work happened

machine_hours.description: operating-hour meter reading at the time of service — the preferred hour source

next_due_at.description: the date the next inspection/service falls due

occurred_at.description: when the maintenance record was submitted; the date the retention clock runs from

project.description: the project the plant was working on when serviced

service_cost.description: the total cost of the service

service_date.description: the date carried on the form, where it differs from submission time

source_units.description: the source unit each measure arrived in, beside the canonical unit

tenant_payload.description: the tenant's own form questions and answers — servicing notes, faults found, parts, cost components, media/signature answers

unplanned.description: 1 when this maintenance event was a breakdown, 0 when it was planned work

worker.description: the worker who submitted the form; an anchor, not a declared axis
